name: Zepho
title: Esau's son and Edomite tribal chief
summary: Zepho (also known as Zepho) was a descendant of Esau through his son Eliphaz and his concubine Timna. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as one of the tribal chiefs of Edom. As an Edomite chief, he represented one of the clans that settled in the Seir mountains.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Esau's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Zepho is listed as a son of Eliphaz and Timna in the genealogy of Esau's descendants in the land of Edom.

keyEvents.title: Counted among the chiefs of Edom
keyEvents.description: Zepho is mentioned as one of the tribal chiefs descended from Eliphaz in the land of Edom, showing his position as a clan leader.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the genealogy of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Zepho is mentioned again in the genealogy of Chronicles as part of Eliphaz's sons, confirming his place in Esau's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Part of Edom's national origin
keyEvents.description: As one of the tribal chiefs in Edom, Zepho helped shape the Edomite nation, which later became an important neighbor and rival to Israel.
